question: Which athlete's victory marked India's inaugural gold medal moment in the Youth Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jeremy Lalrinnunga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jeremy Lalrinnunga** became the first Indian athlete to win a **gold medal at the Youth Olympics** by achieving this feat during the **2018 Summer Youth Olympics** held in **Buenos Aires, Argentina**.
 
• He competed in the **Men's 62 kg weightlifting category** and lifted a total of **274 kg** (124 kg in snatch and 150 kg in clean and jerk) to secure the gold medal.
 
• This victory marked a historic moment for **India**, as it was the first-ever gold medal won by an Indian in the history of the Youth Olympics.
 
• Jeremy Lalrinnunga hails from **Mizoram**, India, and is known for his exceptional talent in weightlifting, having trained at the **Army Sports Institute in Pune**.
 
• His win not only brought glory to the nation but also inspired young athletes across India to excel in sports, especially in disciplines like weightlifting.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jeremy Lalrinnunga:**

 
 
• Born on **26 October 2002**, Jeremy hails from **Aizawl, Mizoram**.
 
• He started his weightlifting journey at a young age and trained under the guidance of experienced coaches at the **Army Sports Institute, Pune**.
 
• Jeremy has been a part of various international competitions and has won multiple medals, showcasing his potential as a rising star in Indian weightlifting.
 
• His Youth Olympics gold medal win was a precursor to his future successes in the senior weightlifting circuit.
 
 
 
• **Youth Olympics:**
 
 
• The **Youth Olympic Games** is an international multi-sport event organized by the **International Olympic Committee (IOC)** for athletes aged 15-18.
 
• The event aims to develop young athletes and promote the Olympic values of **excellence, friendship, and respect**.
 
• The **2018 Summer Youth Olympics** was the third edition of the event and was hosted in **Buenos Aires, Argentina**, from **6 to 18 October 2018**.
 
• India participated in various sports and achieved a significant medal tally, including the historic gold by Jeremy Lalrinnunga.
 
 
 
• **Weightlifting:**
 
 
• Weightlifting is a sport that tests an athlete's strength through two main lifts: the **snatch** and the **clean and jerk**.
 
• Competitions are held across various weight categories, with athletes aiming to lift the maximum weight in each category.
 
• India has a rich history in weightlifting, with athletes like **Karnam Malleswari** and **Mirabai Chanu** bringing international laurels in the sport.
 
• Weightlifting requires rigorous training, discipline, and proper technique to excel at the global level.
 
 
 
• **Other Indian Youth Olympics Achievements:**
 
 
• In addition to Jeremy Lalrinnunga's gold, Indian athletes won several medals in the 2018 Youth Olympics, including **Manu Bhaker** (shooting) and **Suraj Panwar** (athletics).
 
• The performance of Indian athletes at the Youth Olympics reflects the growing support and investment in youth sports in India.
 
• Such achievements highlight the importance of initiatives like **Khelo India** in nurturing young talent and preparing them for international competitions.
